grh_dbf15e922d90619b61cf.title: Mister Chan
paragraphs: Mr. Chan, an elderly Chinese tailor in New York, has spent decades measuring the people around him as carefully as he measures cloth. Memories of famine, disease and family loss in China mingle with his observations of impatient customers, changing generations, condescension and a society increasingly driven by money and possessions. He takes quiet pride in craftsmanship and independence, rejecting both petty extortion and well-meant attempts to organize his life for him. One night, alone in his shop and reflecting on the world he has watched change around him, he smells smoke from a growing fire. Part of him wants to flee while another part remains still, and he becomes unable to make himself move. After the blaze, an ambulance crew carries his body from the gutted shop, leaving those outside to confront how little they really understood the old tailor whose life had unfolded among them.

grh_dba7c1f5874968853029.title: Golden Fleece
paragraphs: Harry takes a job as captain of Nadia's yacht by using forged master's papers, despite having almost no nautical experience. With a real sailor covering for him, he discovers the vessel is carrying explosives and an enormous secret shipment of gold to China, where Nadia's father, a powerful warlord, awaits it. After reaching China, thieves seize the yacht and Harry joins the pursuit. During the final fight Nadia and Harry escape as the explosive-laden ship and its fortune are lost at sea, reportedly taking half a billion dollars in gold with it. Harry later tries to sell an investor the location of the wreck as a salvage opportunity, only to discover his audience is the colony's chief of police and be ordered out of town.
